Not the place it used to be
Sep 2026 • Business
Over the last 5 years I have been to B3 multiple times. One of my favourite steak restaurants. Definitely 5 star rating. I was so happy when they opened a 2nd restaurant in Thao Dien as this was much more convenient in stead of going to District 1. And I was even more happy to experience that the quality was the same as their flagship restaurant.

But today, I was really disappointed (and seeing how empty the place was I believe I am not the only one). The B3 experience is completely gone. No home made fries anymore, all sides half portion, sauces are poor quality and service is so so. 

I am not 100% sure but I hear that it is because of a new owner. Anyhow, they lost a loyal customer.
